terms.gloss: put up for all to see: post
evidence: Cic. Att. 8.9.2: in pūblicō epistulam (sc. prōpōnere; Lewis & Short)
terms.comment: A classical word in its own sense: to put a notice up in a public place for people to read, as Cicero complains that a letter of his was put up in public (Att. 8.9.2); Traupman has it for posting on a bulletin board (p. 363). Posting online is the same act, and that application is modern: no reference work has a word for it.

phrases.latin: ī, puer, et citus haec aliquā prōpōne columnā
phrases.english: go, boy, and quickly post this up on some column

sources: No source has a word for posting online.
John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency, p. 363.
